works.body:
Hello! I came across your work and I really liked it! So I would like to request you to draw my characters! ^^ My reference sheets are below. Raven is a black-haired girl who is very playful and often/loves to tease Cain. She's a bit bratty and likes to pull tricks on him, and a bit obsessed too. The other character is Cain. He is serious but gets shy easily. He likes to sleep a lot. They are a couple! You can decide the pose and expression based on the information and references! There are multiple outfits in the folder, you can pick any one of the outfit you’d like to draw them in! If you don't feel comfortable with my request, please cancel I will understand. Thank you for considering my request~
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AXCQHs2iefDiitRaz6C6f0P73DEdH2Ex   

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aw7QehuVGFEb3i7qwj0LmS9TllGELrMr

先生、こんにちは！私のOCのうち2人の依頼をお願いしたいです。

(1) ノア/190cm

右腕を隠すように袖を結んでいる（詳細はコンセプト画像参照）。トラウマからくる冷めた性格のようです。服装はいくつかあるので、好きなものを選んで描いてください！

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/118jb3GVZ_mbrstKwWa-Jk5fF_YyrSEqj

(2) ヴァローラ/165cm

 おてんばでおっとりした性格のヴァンパイア・ハントレス。剣は無くても良い。

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/110k2yJBFHCuyXvHRoSUfceqgJoyqPOTZ

二人の関係はヴァンパイアとヴァンパイア・ハントレス！お互いにかなり憎み合っている。ちょっと不気味な雰囲気にしたいです！また、服装も自由に変えてください。

構図やポーズなど、その他の要素についてはお任せします！

よろしくお願いします！
